## Documented launch configuration shape

The staged adapter schema supports exactly the `launch` session kind and
requires `request` and `program`; `attach` is rejected with a typed error:

```json
{
  "request": "launch",
  "program": "/path/to/script.pl"
}
```

## Invalidation

Debugger cells invalidate when any bound DAP subject changes:

- #9516 contract or aggregate receipt digest change
- DU01 registry acceptance manifest recording a merged-and-released subject
- a committed exact-source receipt recording a pass

Unrelated Zed LSP cells are not erased by a DAP subject change.

## Limitations

- The official-registry journey has not run: no released official registry entry serves the DAP-capable perl extension yet.
- The linux/macOS rows of the bound #9516 aggregate receipt stay managed_extracted_not_executed; those matching-host executions are owned by the #9516 closeout residual, not by this stage.
- This receipt consumes the checked #9516 contract and aggregate receipt; it does not re-derive public asset selection, digests, or the recorded Windows member divergence (#9485 and #7980 own those).
- The exact-source stage promotes individual cells only from a genuine committed #9486 receipt binding the perl-dap adapter identity; no such receipt is committed, so every exact-source cell stays not_proven.
- The exact-source stage boolean counts only receipts that bind the exact perl-dap adapter identity; a Zed LSP exact-source receipt sharing the zed_host_compat.v1 family never promotes the DAP stage.
